settings.heading: Give the gift of sleep
settings.body: Beautiful things for better nights, slower mornings and the bedside in between. One gift box and four pieces, packed by hand.
settings.image_alt: The Gift of Sleep Box tied with a clay rose ribbon, seen from above on a powder blue ground

settings.quote: For the person who needs nothing
settings.body:
Except a good night's sleep. A silk mask and pillowcase cut from the same run, a journal for either end of the day, and a lavender wrap with a good weight to it. The ritual card sits on top, and your message is printed on a card and placed above it.

Flowers last a week. The box stays on the bedside table.
settings.image_alt: The open box with the lid propped behind it, tissue folded back over the contents

settings.text: Write down what is still in your head.

settings.heading: A message on the card
settings.text: Up to 250 characters, printed and placed on top of the tissue

settings.heading: Initials, soon
settings.text: Monogramming on the silk is coming, added properly rather than quickly

settings.heading: Straight to their door
settings.text: No invoice in the box, no pricing on the outside

settings.heading: Packed by hand
settings.text: In our Melbourne studio, sent tracked with Australia Post
